rationale: The buyer is clear — enterprise Salesforce admins and IT security teams at companies running corporate SSO — and they genuinely pay for Salesforce tooling. However, the solution is fundamentally a SAML/identity middleware adapter requiring deep integration with Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, and Salesforce's MFA framework: this is not buildable as a Claude prompt plus a landing page and Stripe link, and it cannot run autonomously post-launch (each customer requires custom SSO configuration). Both buildability_with_ai (2) and operational_autonomy (2) fail their build-gate floors by a wide margin, and the weighted total of 4.3 sits below the validate threshold of 5.5.
solution_plan: This is an enterprise identity integration product — it would need to act as a SAML proxy that translates corporate MFA signals (DUO, Okta MFA) into the specific AMR attributes Salesforce requires per scope. Building it requires deep SSO protocol work and per-customer configuration by a solutions engineer, not a Claude prompt. A solo non-technical operator could not realistically build, sell (requires enterprise sales cycles), or maintain (requires ongoing SSO support) this product. Drop this and look for a lighter-weight adjacent opportunity if the Salesforce-admin segment proves valuable.
notes: Fails buildability_with_ai (2 < 6 floor) and operational_autonomy (2 < 7 floor). Total 4.3 also below min_total_to_validate (5.5). Correct stage: drop.
